- Use a Kadane-like linear scan to track current_min and global_min: initialize both to nums[0]. For each subsequent x, set current_min = min(x, current_min + x); update global_min = min(global_min, current_min).
- Handle edge cases: nums is assumed non-empty per spec; works with all-negative, all-positive, and mixed values; returns an integer sum.
- Time complexity O(n) with a single pass and O(1) extra space.
